passages.note: Quoted words ("These are medical decisions that people have the right to make a choice over") show the pro-abortion-rights side but name no gestational limit or exception rule; the council resolution is reported only by news (H15) and is not coded as a record.
"reaffirming our commitment in support of abortion rights and the right to choose" shows a side only; a declared right with no stated limit is silence on limits (V4.2).

Reaction to the state supreme court upholding the 1864 ban ("If we cannot make decisions about our own bodies, ourselves, not politicians, not the state") shows opposition to a ban but names no limit; no date is printed in the excerpt.

rows.reasoning: Her own words ("These are medical decisions that people have the right to make a choice over"; "reaffirming our commitment in support of abortion rights and the right to choose") place her on the side of legal abortion, but none states a gestational limit or its absence, so they cannot separate "keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit" from "keep abortion legal through the second trimester" or "allow abortion during the first trimester". A declared right with no named limit is silence on limits (V4.2), so the row is direction-only.

quotes.text: These are medical decisions that people have the right to make a choice over.

In the absence of Congressional action to enshrine Roe v. Wade into federal law, it is up to local governments to stand up to protect bodily autonomy and the rights of pregnant persons from repressive state laws
